items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Trigger Alpert (phonetic spelling) had been with Bill Miller's band.

ctx.x: Yes, and Trigger Alpert (phonetic spelling) had been with Bill Miller's band. Al Klink, Sid Cooper were Miller and Dorsey from Bill's band, and Nick and Joe Ferrante and Bobby Nichols from Dorsey. Nick and Joe Ferrante from McKinley's band. Vern Friley from McKinley's band.
In those times we never used tuba or bass trombone. We had Bill Barber the first time on tuba, because he had been with--we heard him with Gil's thing with Miles.
